Explicit analytic prerequisite restatement:
E has the same finite real Hilbert/Borel/full-space structure including dimension zero. V is C2 with alpha,beta NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta, all-point/all-vector alpha I<=Hess V<=beta I; eta>0 and beta eta<=1.
Construct the true Gaussian/Gibbs augmentation J, common Markov/disintegrating R/S, exact reflected S_y=(2x-y)#R_y=volume.tilted(-W_y), W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), C2 and positive integrable partition.
For every fiber fix original dense closable exact compact-smooth gradient D_y with closed closure before epsilon/forcing. For each epsilon>0/f in L2(S_y), one actual u/G/r serves all C2 compact chi. Derive all local/global volume facts and PDE inputs from the accepted actual conditional localization. No measurable joint fiberwise solution/class selector, unreflected RGO identity or localized weighted-domain membership is assumed.
Construct genuine common R/S and original fiber D_y before epsilon/f; choose ONE actual u before ALL C2 compact cutoffs. Retain all-domain variational identity, ordinary locally integrable u/G, all C1 compact directional weak-gradient tests, locally integrable squared r=epsilon*u+inner(grad W_y,G)-f, compact-volume L2 of u/G/r and all original C2 compact distribution tests. For every C2 compact chi retain v=chi*u, Gchi=chi*G+u*grad chi, Fchi=chi*r+2 inner(grad chi,G)+u Delta chi, all three global-volume L2/support inclusions, all C1 localized weak-gradient and C2 localized PDE identities with legal products. For each cutoff, Construct actual vc,Fc in complex L2(volume), with vc=volume-a.e. ofReal(v) and Fc=volume-a.e. ofReal(Fchi). For every complex Schwartz psi, both (Delta psi)*ofReal(v) and psi*ofReal(Fchi) are L1 and their integrals equal. For T_v=Lp.toTemperedDistribution(vc) and T_F=Lp.toTemperedDistribution(Fc), derive Delta T_v=T_F and MemSobolev 2 2 T_v. The latter uses B2 T=T-(2pi)^(-2) Delta T and a genuine complex L2 witness, not a supplied regularity result. Reflected/RGO laws/operators/quarter Hessian and Dirichlet scales remain distinct.
Derive actual all-complex-Schwartz tested PDE with both products L1, genuine complex volume-L2 classes/AE embeddings, actual TD Laplacian and MemSobolev2 using B2=I-(2pi)^-2 Delta. Genuine conditional same originalD before epsilon/f, one actualu before allC2 compactcutoffs; retain parent properties. No real mixed-second representatives/Hessian, original weighted localized-domain membership/core/Bochner, BL/Poincare/epsilon0/measurable fiber selector/full4.1/main/composition. Reflected/RGO laws/operators/scales distinct; TV does not transfer unbounded cost.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : NNReal} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α:ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, (α:ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β:ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β:ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    let W := fun y u : E => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) + ‖u-y‖^2/(8*η)
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (R y).map (fun x => (2:ℝ) • x-y)) ∧
      ∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun u => -W y u) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ 2 (W y) ∧ Integrable (fun u => Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        0 < (∫ u, Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        ∃ D : Lp ℝ 2 (S y) →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 (S y),
          Dense (D.domain : Set (Lp ℝ 2 (S y))) ∧ D.IsClosable ∧ D.closure.IsClosed ∧
          (∀ (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) (v : Lp E 2 (S y)), (u,v) ∈ D.graph ↔
            ∃ f : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧
              u =ᵐ[S y] f ∧ v =ᵐ[S y] gradient f) ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 (S y),
      ∃ u : D.closure.domain,
        (∀ v : D.closure.domain,
          ε * ⟪(u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)), (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫ +
            ⟪D.closure u, D.closure v⟫ = ⟪f, (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => D.closure u x) ∧
        (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ v : E,
          Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
          (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) =
            - ∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ‖ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
          inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ K : Set E, IsCompact K →
          MemLp (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => D.closure u x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) 2 (volume.restrict K)) ∧
        (∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
          (∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) =
            ∫ x, (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
              inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
        ∀ χ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 χ → HasCompactSupport χ →
    let v := fun x => χ x * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x
    let Gχ := fun x => χ x • D.closure u x + (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x • gradient χ x
    let Fχ := fun x => χ x * (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x + inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) + 2 * inner ℝ (gradient χ x) (D.closure u x) +
      (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian χ x
    MemLp v 2 volume ∧ MemLp Gχ 2 volume ∧ MemLp Fχ 2 volume ∧
    tsupport v ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Gχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Fχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧
    (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ a : E,
      Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
      (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) = -∫ x, v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
    (∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      Integrable (fun x => v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => Fχ x * φ x) ∧
      (∫ x, v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) = ∫ x, Fχ x * φ x) ∧
    ∃ vc Fc : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure E),
      vc =ᵐ[volume] (fun x => (v x : ℂ)) ∧
      Fc =ᵐ[volume] (fun x => (Fχ x : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ ψ : SchwartzMap E ℂ,
        Integrable (fun x => (Laplacian.laplacian ψ) x * (v x : ℂ)) volume ∧
        Integrable (fun x => ψ x * (Fχ x : ℂ)) volume ∧
        (∫ x, (Laplacian.laplacian ψ) x * (v x : ℂ)) = ∫ x, ψ x * (Fχ x : ℂ)) ∧
      Laplacian.laplacian (Lp.toTemperedDistribution vc) = Lp.toTemperedDistribution Fc ∧
      MemSobolev 2 2 (Lp.toTemperedDistribution vc)
decoder_context: E is finite-dimensional real Hilbert with Borel measurable structure and canonical ordinary Lebesgue volume, including dimension zero. All section instances remain part of the contract. NNReal denotes nonnegative real scalars.

MemLp f2volume means actual volume-a.e. strong measurability and finite L2 norm. Lp F2mu is the genuine L2 quotient with selected standard measurable representative; the statement explicitly binds vc/Fc to the real pointwise inputs via volume-AE ofReal identities. No support equality of selected complex quotient representatives is asserted.

SchwartzMap E complex is the genuine smooth rapidly decreasing test function on real E. Its derivatives are real Frechet derivatives. Laplacian.laplacian is the actual finite-basis trace on smooth test functions, and the true distribution Laplacian on tempered distributions. The rough scalar v/u is not given pointwise classical derivatives.

Lp.toTemperedDistribution at exponent2 and volume is the genuine complex tempered distribution embedding, evaluated on psi by integral psi(x)*vc(x), with no complex conjugation. Real/imaginary CLMs are real-linear; the LpTD and multiplier linearity are complex-linear.

MemSobolev s p T means an actual Lp(volume) witness fprime with besselPotential E complex s T=LpTD(fprime). besselPotential is Fourier multiplier (1+norm(x)^2)^(s/2). The fixed Fourier convention yields Delta T=-(2pi)^2 FM(norm^2)T. Order2 membership here is this exact Bessel-Sobolev statement, not an asserted real Hessian representative or weighted-core theorem.

LinearPMap is the original real-linear partial gradient on a submodule domain; D.graph is actual graph, D.IsClosable its single-valued graph closure and D.closure that same closed operator. The source D is fixed before epsilon/f; u before all chi; complex classes after each chi and before all Schwartz psi.

Measure.tilted h is exp(h)/integral exp(h) times the original measure, requiring the stated integrability/positive normalization facts; Kernel IsMarkovKernel and IsCondKernel denote actual measurable probability transition and joint disintegration, Measure.map/prod actual pushforward/product and stdGaussian the genuine standard finite real Hilbert Gaussian. ContDiff1/2/infinity and compact topological support have their usual exact Lean meanings.

theorem conditional_localized_sobolev {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : NNReal} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α:ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, (α:ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β:ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β:ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    let W := fun y u : E => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) + ‖u-y‖^2/(8*η)
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (R y).map (fun x => (2:ℝ) • x-y)) ∧
      ∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun u => -W y u) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ 2 (W y) ∧ Integrable (fun u => Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        0 < (∫ u, Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        ∃ D : Lp ℝ 2 (S y) →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 (S y),
          Dense (D.domain : Set (Lp ℝ 2 (S y))) ∧ D.IsClosable ∧ D.closure.IsClosed ∧
          (∀ (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) (v : Lp E 2 (S y)), (u,v) ∈ D.graph ↔
            ∃ f : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧
              u =ᵐ[S y] f ∧ v =ᵐ[S y] gradient f) ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 (S y),
      ∃ u : D.closure.domain,
        (∀ v : D.closure.domain,
          ε * ⟪(u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)), (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫ +
            ⟪D.closure u, D.closure v⟫ = ⟪f, (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => D.closure u x) ∧
        (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ v : E,
          Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
          (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) =
            - ∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ‖ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
          inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ K : Set E, IsCompact K →
          MemLp (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => D.closure u x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) 2 (volume.restrict K)) ∧
        (∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
          (∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) =
            ∫ x, (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x +
              inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
        ∀ χ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 χ → HasCompactSupport χ →
    let v := fun x => χ x * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x
    let Gχ := fun x => χ x • D.closure u x + (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x • gradient χ x
    let Fχ := fun x => χ x * (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x + inner ℝ (gradient (W y) x) (D.closure u x) - f x) + 2 * inner ℝ (gradient χ x) (D.closure u x) +
      (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * Laplacian.laplacian χ x
    MemLp v 2 volume ∧ MemLp Gχ 2 volume ∧ MemLp Fχ 2 volume ∧
    tsupport v ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Gχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ tsupport Fχ ⊆ tsupport χ ∧
    (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ a : E,
      Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
      (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (Gχ x) a) = -∫ x, v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) ∧
    (∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      Integrable (fun x => v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => Fχ x * φ x) ∧
      (∫ x, v x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) = ∫ x, Fχ x * φ x) ∧
    ∃ vc Fc : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure E),
      vc =ᵐ[volume] (fun x => (v x : ℂ)) ∧
      Fc =ᵐ[volume] (fun x => (Fχ x : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ ψ : SchwartzMap E ℂ,
        Integrable (fun x => (Laplacian.laplacian ψ) x * (v x : ℂ)) volume ∧
        Integrable (fun x => ψ x * (Fχ x : ℂ)) volume ∧
        (∫ x, (Laplacian.laplacian ψ) x * (v x : ℂ)) = ∫ x, ψ x * (Fχ x : ℂ)) ∧
      Laplacian.laplacian (Lp.toTemperedDistribution vc) = Lp.toTemperedDistribution Fc ∧
      MemSobolev 2 2 (Lp.toTemperedDistribution vc) := by
  obtain ⟨R,S,hR,hS,hcond,hSR,hfiber⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalLocalizedResolvent.conditional_localized_resolvent hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨R,S,hR,hS,hcond,hSR,?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨hSy,hW,hI,hZ,D,hDense,hClose,hClosed,hgraph,hsolve⟩ := hfiber y
  refine ⟨hSy,hW,hI,hZ,D,hDense,hClose,hClosed,hgraph,?_⟩
  intro ε hε f
  obtain ⟨u,hu,huL,hGL,hd,hr2,hl,hp,hcut⟩ := hsolve ε hε f
  refine ⟨u,hu,huL,hGL,hd,hr2,hl,hp,?_⟩
  intro χ hχ hc
  obtain ⟨hv,hg,hf,hvs,hgs,hfs,hfirst,hsecond⟩ := hcut χ hχ hc
  refine ⟨hv,hg,hf,hvs,hgs,hfs,hfirst,hsecond,?_⟩
  exact AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.CompactWeakPoissonSobolev.compact_weak_poisson_sobolev
    _ _ (tsupport χ) hc hvs hfs hv hf hsecond

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalLocalizedSobolev

reconstruction.text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with NormedAddCommGroup, InnerProductSpace R, FiniteDimensional R, MeasurableSpace and BorelSpace instances and canonical ordinary Lebesgue volume; dimension zero is allowed. Let V:E->R, alpha,beta:NNReal and eta:R. Assume alpha cast to R is strictly positive, alpha<=beta, V is C2, and for every x,a in E,
  alpha*||a||^2 <= (fderiv R (fderiv R V) x a) a <= beta*||a||^2.
Assume eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. Define the actual measures and potential
  mu=volume.tilted(x->-V(x)),
  J=map((x,g)->(x,x+sqrt(eta)*g),mu.prod(stdGaussian E)),
  W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+||z-y||^2/(8*eta).
The tilted measure has density exp(-V)/integral exp(-V) against volume; the Gaussian is standard on the real Hilbert space, and prod and map are actual independent product and pushforward.
There exist kernels R,S:E->Measure E with the following simultaneous properties: both are Markov kernels; R is a true conditional kernel disintegrating J.map Prod.swap; for every y in E, S(y)=(R(y)).map(x->2*x-y).
For every y in E, S(y)=volume.tilted(z->-W_y(z)), W_y is C2, exp(-W_y) is Lebesgue integrable, and its Lebesgue integral is strictly positive. For this y there exists a real-linear partial operator D:L2(S(y);R)->L2(S(y);E), with dense domain in the actual scalar L2 space, D closable and D.closure closed. Its graph is exactly characterized by: for every scalar L2 class a and vector L2 class H, (a,H) belongs to graph(D) if and only if there exists a smooth compactly supported real function phi with a=phi S(y)-almost everywhere and H=gradient(phi) S(y)-almost everywhere.
For this same D, for every real epsilon>0 and every f in scalar L2(S(y)), there exists u in D.closure.domain satisfying all the following conclusions simultaneously. Let u_rep,f_rep be the standard representatives of the actual scalar L2 classes and G_rep the standard vector L2 representative of G=D.closure(u). Abbreviate the exact displayed scalar expression by
  r(x)=epsilon*u_rep(x)+<gradient(W_y)(x),G_rep(x)>_E-f_rep(x).
(a) For every z in D.closure.domain,
  epsilon*<u,z>_{L2(S(y);R)}+<D.closure(u),D.closure(z)>_{L2(S(y);E)}=<f,z>_{L2(S(y);R)}.
(b) u_rep and G_rep are locally integrable with respect to ordinary Lebesgue volume.
(c) For every real C1 compactly supported psi and every direction a in E, both x->psi(x)*<G_rep(x),a>_E and x->u_rep(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) are volume-integrable and
  integral psi(x)*<G_rep(x),a>_E dx = - integral u_rep(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) dx.
(d) x->||r(x)||^2, using the scalar real norm, is locally volume-integrable.
(e) For every compact K contained in E, u_rep,G_rep and r each satisfy MemLp at exponent 2 for volume.restrict K, including actual a.e. strong measurability and finite norm with respect to that restricted measure.
(f) For every real C2 compactly supported phi, both x->u_rep(x)*Delta(phi)(x) and x->r(x)*phi(x) are volume-integrable and
  integral u_rep(x)*Delta(phi)(x) dx = integral r(x)*phi(x) dx.
(g) For every real C2 compactly supported chi, define the following actual functions (v_chi denotes the statement's let-defined v):
  v_chi(x)=chi(x)*u_rep(x),
  G_chi(x)=chi(x) scalar-multiplied by G_rep(x) + u_rep(x) scalar-multiplied by gradient(chi)(x),
  F_chi(x)=chi(x)*r(x)+2*<gradient(chi)(x),G_rep(x)>_E+u_rep(x)*Delta(chi)(x).
Then v_chi,G_chi,F_chi each satisfy actual global MemLp 2 volume. Their topological supports each are contained in tsupport(chi): tsupport(v_chi) subset tsupport(chi), tsupport(G_chi) subset tsupport(chi), and tsupport(F_chi) subset tsupport(chi).
For every real C1 compactly supported psi and a in E, both x->psi(x)*<G_chi(x),a>_E and x->v_chi(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) are volume-integrable, and
  integral psi(x)*<G_chi(x),a>_E dx = - integral v_chi(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) dx.
For every real C2 compactly supported phi, both x->v_chi(x)*Delta(phi)(x) and x->F_chi(x)*phi(x) are volume-integrable, and
  integral v_chi(x)*Delta(phi)(x) dx = integral F_chi(x)*phi(x) dx.
Furthermore for this chi there exist vc,Fc in Lp C 2 volume with vc=(x->(v_chi(x):C)) volume-almost everywhere and Fc=(x->(F_chi(x):C)) volume-almost everywhere, such that all the following hold for these same classes:
  For every psi in SchwartzMap E C, x->Delta(psi)(x)*(v_chi(x):C) and x->psi(x)*(F_chi(x):C) are both volume-integrable and
    integral Delta(psi)(x)*(v_chi(x):C) dx = integral psi(x)*(F_chi(x):C) dx;
  Delta(Lp.toTemperedDistribution(vc)) = Lp.toTemperedDistribution(Fc);
  MemSobolev 2 2 (Lp.toTemperedDistribution(vc)).
One pair R,S works for all y; each y has one D fixed before all epsilon/forcing choices; each epsilon,f has one u fixed before all cutoffs; after each cutoff one pair vc,Fc is chosen before all Schwartz tests. All y have the stated density/operator conclusions, not merely almost every y. Conditional-kernel disintegration retains its usual scope, without claiming identities for every possible version on exceptional y. All Hilbert inner products use S(y); all unannotated local-integrability, compact restrictions, global localized L2 and distribution/Schwartz integrals use ordinary volume. The arbitrary real C2 compact cutoff has no positivity, range or plateau assumption. There is no joint measurable y-dependent D/u/class selection or localized weighted-domain/core assertion.
Lp C 2 volume is the genuine complex L2 quotient with its standard measurable representative. These volume-a.e. identities bind the chosen classes to the actual pointwise real functions cast into C; they do not assert pointwise support identities for the chosen complex representatives. Every Schwartz test is a genuine smooth rapidly decreasing complex function on the real space E, and no compact-support restriction is imposed on it. Its derivatives are real Frechet derivatives. Pairings and displayed integrals use ordinary complex multiplication with no complex conjugation. Lp.toTemperedDistribution is the genuine complex-linear distribution embedding whose value at psi is integral psi(x)*the L2 representative(x) dx. The distribution Laplacian is the true tempered-distribution operator. MemSobolev 2 2 means there exists an actual fprime in Lp C 2 volume with besselPotential E C 2 of the displayed distribution equal to Lp.toTemperedDistribution(fprime); its multiplier is (1+||xi||^2)^(2/2). The approved Fourier convention is Delta T=-(2*pi)^2 FM(||xi||^2)T. This order-2 Bessel-Sobolev assertion is not a pointwise classical Laplacian, a real Hessian representative, or a weighted-core conclusion.
